events.caption: Push red toward blue; green is not a participant.

setup: Trigger red–blue contact. The boost applies when the contact ends.
name: Collision boost

oracle.name: Collision boost
oracle.law: When contact between two of red, blue, and green ends, both participants' remaining linear velocities are multiplied by 1.8. Outgoing speeds can still be lower than incoming speeds.
oracle.plain: When two balls separate after a collision, both get a speed boost.
oracle.plain_zh: 两球碰撞后分开时，都会获得一次额外加速。
oracle.condition: Contact between two experiment balls ends.
oracle.effect: Both participants’ remaining linear velocities are multiplied by 1.8.
oracle.scope: The third ball is unchanged. Floor, wall and apparatus contacts do not trigger this gain.

reference: Identical initial preparation and impulses, with the altered program disabled.
